product_overview: TAC Cargo is an enterprise-grade logistics and freight management SaaS platform designed for the Imphal–Delhi corridor. It provides real-time shipment tracking, fleet operations, analytics dashboards, and an advanced invoice management system. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Supabase, it offers a server-first architecture emphasizing security, performance, accessibility, and extensibility, making it suitable for complex logistics workflows.
core_goals: Enable secure and robust user authentication and session management.
Provide comprehensive shipment lifecycle management with real-time tracking.
Facilitate efficient manifest and customer data management with bulk operations and search capabilities.
Implement a professional-grade, standards-compliant invoice management system with PDF generation and payment processing.
Integrate multi-channel notifications including email, SMS, and WhatsApp.
Offer intuitive dashboard analytics with charts and KPIs to monitor business metrics.
Maintain enterprise-grade security via RLS policies, secure functions, and encryption.
Support webhook integrations and RESTful APIs for external system connectivity.
Ensure accessibility compliance (WCAG AA) and enforce token-based design system for UI consistency.
Enable scalable deployment and observability with monitoring, error tracking, and performance metrics.
key_features: User Authentication with Supabase, session handling, and protected routes.
Shipment Management with create, update, cancel, and search functionalities including bulk operations.
Manifest management supporting creation, locking, dispatch, and completion workflows with shipment assignment controls.
Customer CRUD with autocomplete search support.
Invoice Management implementing enterprise-level standards (IATA, FIATA, GST) with status workflows, PDF and label generation, payment tracking, and audit logs.
Payment Processing integrated with Razorpay for seamless payment capture and webhook handling.
Real-time Shipment Tracking system with public-facing tracking pages and event timelines.
Warehouse Inventory Management and barcode Scanning modules.
Multi-channel Notification Services via Email, SMS, and WhatsApp.
PDF document generation for invoices and shipping labels with REST APIs.
Dashboard Analytics featuring overview cards, charts, and mission control UI components.
Security utilities enforcing headers, CORS, and environment validation.
RESTful API routes for external integration and automation.
user_flow_summary: Users authenticate via Supabase Auth and access the dashboard secured by Protected Routes.
Users can create shipments by entering detailed consignee and shipment information; shipments can then be updated, canceled, or assigned to manifests.
Operators manage manifests through creation, locking shipments to a manifest, dispatch, arrival logging, and marking manifests complete.
Users manage customers with autocomplete search and perform CRUD operations.
Invoices can be created based on shipment details or customer orders, viewed, sent via email or WhatsApp, and PDFs can be regenerated.
Payment workflows allow users to make and verify payments through Razorpay integration and receive status updates via webhooks.
Real-time tracking is accessible by entering shipment references on a public tracking page showing status and history.
Warehouse staff manage inventory counts, adjustments, and scan barcodes during shipment processing.
Users receive notifications through configured channels about shipment status, payments, and invoice events.
Administrators view dashboard analytics to monitor KPIs and mission control panels for operations status.
Developers and integrators interact with RESTful API endpoints to automate shipment, manifest, invoice, payment, and customer workflows.
The platform enforces security checks, rate limiting, and audit logs to maintain system integrity.
validation_criteria: All API endpoints must validate inputs using Zod schemas and handle errors gracefully with standardized ActionResult types.
Authentication via Supabase must prevent unauthorized access, with fully tested session management and protected routes.
Shipment, manifest, customer, invoice, and payment operations must support full CRUD and bulk operations as specified.
PDF generation for invoices and labels must produce valid, printable documents matching enterprise standards.
Payment processing integrates reliably with Razorpay including webhook validation and error handling.
Real-time tracking pages must display accurate shipment statuses and timelines, synchronizing with backend updates.
Notification services must reliably send messages via email, SMS, and WhatsApp with audit logs of sent notifications.
Dashboard analytics must render accurate overview cards, charts, and metrics consistent with the data inputs.
All UI must comply with the OKLCH color token design system and enforce accessibility via WCAG AA guidelines.
RLS policies must be scoped to organizations, verified by automated tests to prevent cross-tenant access.
Performance targets require sub-2 second page loads, optimized bundle size, and server startup under 1 second.
Security headers, CSRF protection, environment validation, and CORS policies must be enforced in production.
Comprehensive unit tests and e2e tests for all core workflows must pass with 100% completeness.
Deployment readiness requires successful database migrations, environment configuration, and zero critical warnings in lint reports.
